verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's first-project guide explicitly walks through creating a project and an index, adding documents, and running a first search in the web interface. Local install is a single cURL command for a dependency-free binary. Hands-on reports back up the fast start: one user had a working zero-config setup within 30 minutes, and another's Docker deployment 'just worked.' One hobbyist said integration coding plus settings changes took about a week, but that concerns custom integration rather than the quickstart. Missing for 10: no documented time-to-first-search benchmark for the quickstart itself, and that one dissenting hands-on report on setup effort.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart

citations.quote: setting up Meilisearch Cloud, creating a project and an index, adding documents to it, and performing your first search with the default web interface
Adding search to your website takes minutes, not months.
Indexing was about 10x faster and search at least 3x faster, with literally zero config.
